home.title: Organisational assessment
home.body: To answer the questionnaire, open the link your project sent you.

entry.title: Start your assessment
entry.default_welcome: Project {project}. Enter your organisation's name and an email address: we create your file and send you your personal link.
entry.name: Organisation name
entry.email_hint: Your personal link will be sent to this address. It is the only way to recover it.
entry.consent: I have read how our data is used for this assessment.
entry.created_body: Keep this link: it lets you come back to your assessment at any time. We also sent it to you by email.
entry.exists_body: A file already exists for this address in this project. We just sent a new link to that address so you can resume.

link.label: Your personal link
link.warning: Anyone with this link can see and change your assessment. Do not share it.
link.note_personal: This link gives access to your organisation's assessment. Anyone who has it can fill it in and edit it: share it with the colleagues involved, not outside your organisation.
link.note_public: Share this link with the project's organisations. Anyone who opens it can start an assessment; they then receive their own personal link by email.

osc.home_intro: The assessment has 9 sections. Fill them in any order, in one or several sittings: each answer is saved as soon as you give it.
osc.submit_hint: The send button appears once all 9 sections are complete.
osc.submit_confirm: Send your assessment? You can still change your answers until your coach closes the session.
osc.guide_generic:
N/A: the practice does not apply to your organisation.
1: the practice is not in place.
2: the practice is partially or informally in place.
3: the practice is documented and fully operational.
osc.support_question: Would you like support from the organisation to put this in place?
osc.locked_banner: Your coach has closed the session: answers can no longer be changed.
osc.resend: Get a new link by email
osc.resent: If this file exists, a new link was sent to the registered address.
osc.deepen_question: Would you like to go deeper on this section?
osc.deepen_hint: If yes, your coach will come back to this section with you in more detail.
osc.data_hint: This information completes the assessment: it is not scored.

report.title: {name} report
report.intro: Here is a summary of your answers, section by section. Practices to strengthen come first.

errors.invalid_link: This link does not exist or has been replaced. Use the latest link you received by email, or contact your coach.
errors.expired_link: This link has expired. Request a new one: it will be sent to the registered email address.
errors.offline: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.link_inactive: This project link is not active. Contact the project team.
errors.invalid_form: Check the name and email address.
errors.captcha_failed: The anti-robot check failed. Try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts from this connection. Try again in an hour.
errors.server_error: The server could not save. Try again in a moment.
errors.locked: The session is closed: changes are not possible.
errors.incomplete: All sections must be complete before sending.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to this file.
errors.not_signed_in: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.email_exists: A CSO with this address already exists in this project.
errors.need_exists: This need is already in the list.
errors.no_framework: No question bank loaded. Run the seed script.
errors.last_admin: At least one administrator must remain.
errors.link_failed: This sign-in link is no longer valid (it works once and lasts one hour). Request a new one.
errors.no_account: No account is linked to this address.
errors.invalid_profile: Check the details entered (first and last name are required).
errors.invalid_section: Enter a name and at least one question.

login.title: Team sign-in
login.sent: If an account exists for this address, a sign-in link was just sent to it. It is valid for one hour.

staff.title: Team area
staff.no_project: You are not part of any project yet.
staff.complete_name: Complete your first and last name: they appear at the top right.

cohort.empty: No CSO yet. Share the project's public link, or add a CSO by hand.
cohort.empty_coach: No CSO is assigned to you yet. Ask the project owner to assign some: you will then see each CSO, even if it has not finished its questionnaire.

needs.title: Aggregated needs
needs.empty: No needs tagged yet. Coaches tag needs during the session.
needs.weakest_hint: The 10 questions with the most "1" answers across the cohort.

team.name: Name
team.revoke_confirm: Revoke {name}'s access to this project? Access ends immediately. Remember to reassign their CSOs.

project.link_disabled: The public link is disabled: nobody can create a file.
project.renew_confirm: Renew the public link? The old link will stop working. CSOs' personal links do not change.
project.offer_coach_choice: Show the list of coaches to the CSO
project.need_delete_confirm: Delete the need "{label}"? It will be removed from all answers.
project.needs_hint: Coaches can also add a need during the session.

dup.confirm: Merge "{drop}" into "{keep}"? Assessments move to the file you keep and the other file is deleted.

subject.revoke_confirm: Revoke the personal link? The CSO will not be able to open its assessment until a new link is generated.
subject.lock_confirm: Close the session? The CSO will no longer be able to change its answers.
subject.share_notes: Show my notes to the CSO
subject.new_assessment_confirm: Create a new assessment for this CSO? A link will be sent by email.
subject.no_assessment: No assessment for this CSO. Create one in the settings.

sheet.score_rule: Section score: average of answers 1 to 3, N/A excluded. Overall: average of the sections of the common framework. Visible to the team only.
sheet.provisional_note: * Provisional value (average of the answers given so far): the section is not complete yet.
sheet.no_data: No answers yet: the chart will appear with the first answers.

session.add_question: Add a question to this assessment
session.guide_1: Start with the overview together with the CSO: spot the weakest sections.
session.guide_2: Here, each card is a question for which the CSO asks for support. Ask why, what it already tried, what is blocking.
session.guide_3: Write your observations in Notes, what will be put in place in Action, and who takes charge in Owner. Everything saves automatically.
session.guide_4: A question deserves support the CSO did not ask for? Switch to the "All questions" filter and tick "Needs support".
session.guide_5: Finally, open the Support plan: your actions are already there, you only need to choose due dates.
session.stats: {n} questions needing support · {m} with an action defined
session.empty_support: No question is marked "needs support". The CSO either asked for nothing or has not finished: try the "Answers 1 and 2" filter.
session.ph_notes: What the CSO says, blockers, what has already been tried…
session.ph_action: What will be put in place…
session.more: Change the answer, tag needs, guide
session.sec_none: No question for this filter in this section.

plan.title: Support plan
plan.hint: Actions and owners come from the session: edit them in the Session tab. Here, only choose each action's due date.
plan.empty: No rows yet: the plan picks up questions that need support or have an action defined in the session.
plan.missing_action: Action not filled in: complete it in the session

personal_link.subject: Your personal link for the assessment

resume_link.subject: Your new link to resume the assessment

login.subject: Your sign-in link

submitted.subject: Assessment submitted: {name}

dashboard.title: {name} dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Find your organisation's details and your tools here.
dashboard.live_hint: The chart updates with every answer. A section becomes final once all its questions are answered.
dashboard.live_empty: Answer a few questions: your profile will appear here.
dashboard.fill_hint: The profile is drawn as you answer: the coloured area appears as soon as 3 sections have at least one answer.

ocat.title: Organisational assessment
ocat.desc: Self-assessment in {n} sections to identify your strengths and priority areas for development.

intro.title: Welcome to the {org} organisational assessment tool
intro.p1: This tool supports you in a self-assessment of your organisational needs. It is a starting point to identify together your strengths and your priority areas for development, so that we can support you better.
intro.p2: The assessment is organised in {n} thematic sections. You can fill them in in any order, in one or several sittings.
intro.p3: For each question, choose the level that best matches the current reality of your organisation:
intro.p4: When you answer 1 or 2, a follow-up question asks whether you would like support from the organisation to help you progress. This helps us identify your needs but does not automatically guarantee support: the decision will be made by mutual agreement.
intro.p5: The honesty of your answers is the condition for support that fits your real needs.

myprofile.title: My profile
myprofile.intro: These details appear at the top right of every page.

settings.link_desc: The CSO opens its assessment with this link. Generating a new link invalidates the old one. Revoking the link cuts access until you generate another.
settings.session_desc: Once the session is closed, the CSO can no longer change its answers. You can reopen it at any time.
settings.share_desc: Your notes are visible to the CSO only if you tick this box. The plan is shared from the "Support plan" tab (status "Shared").
settings.eval_desc: Create a follow-up or end-of-support assessment: the CSO receives a new link by email.

psec.title: Sections specific to this project
psec.intro: Add a whole section with its questions, specific to this project (for example "Export support"). It appears after the 9 sections for every CSO in the project.
psec.note: Its questions are answered like the others (N/A, 1, 2, 3 and support). The section has its own score but does not enter the overall score, which stays comparable across projects.
psec.none: This project has no specific section yet.
psec.delete_section_confirm: Delete the section "{name}" with all its questions? Answers already given will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
psec.delete_question_confirm: Delete this question? Answers already given will be deleted.
psec.kind_title: Which type of section do you want to add?
psec.kind_scored_desc: Questions on 4 levels (N/A, 1, 2, 3) with support requested. The section has its own score and radar axis; it does not enter the overall score, which stays comparable across projects.
psec.kind_data_desc: To collect data or free answers: text, number, yes / no, list of choices. No score, no radar.
psec.help_scored: Paste your questions, one per line: they are answered with the usual labels (N/A, 1, 2, 3).
psec.help_data: Add your questions one by one and choose the expected type of answer for each.
psec.no_score: This section is not scored: it does not appear on the radar and does not enter the scores.
psec.need_question: Add at least one question with a text.
psec.need_choices: A "choice" question needs at least two possible choices.

planx.no_dates: No due date chosen yet: pick dates in the plan and the calendar will appear here.
planx.undated: {n} action(s) without a due date, not shown in the calendar.
planx.cal_hint: The calendar updates as soon as you choose a due date.
planx.downloaded: The Word file has been downloaded.
planx.error: The file could not be generated. Try again, or use the PDF export.
planx.provisional: * Provisional value: the section is not complete yet.

recap.profile_hint: Updates with every answer. Hollow markers and values marked * are provisional until a section is complete. Hover the radar to see the values.

mex.title: Monitoring & evaluation: export to Airtable
mex.intro: Each assessment (baseline, midline, endline) becomes a row in an Airtable table: CSO context, overall score, section scores, completion. A section's score appears there only once the section is complete.
mex.not_configured: Airtable is not configured: set AIRTABLE_TOKEN and AIRTABLE_BASE_ID in Vercel, then redeploy.
mex.setup_hint: Do this once. The Airtable token needs the schema.bases:write scope.
mex.sync_hint: Creates new rows and updates the others. This also happens automatically each time an assessment is submitted.
mex.csv_hint: Same content, without going through Airtable.
mex.exists: The table already exists: you can synchronise.
